about_blocks.text: Road to Recovery Health Clinics™ (RTR) is a renowned rehab center in Ontario, established with the sole purpose of aiding those affected by opioid addiction. With years of experience and a team of dedicated healthcare professionals, RTR has successfully helped numerous individuals recover from opioid addiction.
about_blocks.html: Road to Recovery Health Clinics™ (RTR) is a renowned rehab center in Ontario, established with the sole purpose of aiding those affected by opioid addiction. With years of experience and a team of dedicated healthcare professionals, RTR has successfully helped numerous individuals recover from opioid addiction.

about_blocks.text: RTR specializes in providing highly effective and safe opioid addiction treatments that include methadone, Suboxone®, and Kadian®, among others. Furthermore, we offer alcohol addiction treatment, smoking cessation, and mental health services to give our clients the best possible treatment.

about_blocks.text: Finding Your Mental Toughness with RTR: The SISU Philosophy
about_blocks.html: Finding Your Mental Toughness with RTR: The SISU Philosophy

about_blocks.text: To help our clients achieve full recovery, we follow the Finnish principle of “SISU.” This philosophy aims to find your “second wind” of mental toughness when you are reaching your physical and mental limits. Our goal is to be with you all the way on your Road to Recovery, be it mental, physical, or emotional.

about_blocks.text: Road to Recovery Clinic - Center Overview
about_blocks.html: Road to Recovery Clinic - Center Overview

about_blocks.text: Road to Recovery Clinic is dedicated to helping individuals overcome substance, drug and alcohol abuse. The private rehab, located in Midland, Ontario offers a comprehensive range of treatments that are designed to address the unique needs of each person receiving care. The clinic’s team of experienced professionals utilize evidence-based practices in addition to holistic therapies such as yoga, meditation, and art therapy to ensure that each individual is provided with personalized care that is tailored to their specific needs.
about_blocks.html: Road to Recovery Clinic is dedicated to helping individuals overcome substance, drug and alcohol abuse. The private rehab, located in Midland, Ontario offers a comprehensive range of treatments that are designed to address the unique needs of each person receiving care. The clinic’s team of experienced professionals utilize evidence-based practices in addition to holistic therapies such as yoga, meditation, and art therapy to ensure that each individual is provided with personalized care that is tailored to their specific needs.

about_blocks.text: At Road to Recovery Clinic, there is a focus on treating the whole person, rather than just the addiction or substance abuse. This means that in addition to traditional therapy approaches, nutritional counseling, and family therapy are integrated into each patient’s treatment plan. Through group therapy and counseling, individuals are provided with the opportunity to connect with others experiencing similar struggles, allowing them to build a supportive community throughout their journey to recovery. With the help of the team at Road to Recovery Clinic, individuals can work towards lifelong recovery and regain control of their lives.

faqs.question: What is methadone and how does it work?

answer_blocks.text: Methadone is an opioid agonist used to manage opioid addiction. It works by reducing cravings and withdrawal symptoms while blocking the effects of other opioids.
answer_blocks.html: Methadone is an opioid agonist used to manage opioid addiction. It works by reducing cravings and withdrawal symptoms while blocking the effects of other opioids.

faqs.question: What is Suboxone® and how does it work?

answer_blocks.text: Suboxone® is a combination of buprenorphine and naloxone used to manage opioid addiction. It works by easing withdrawal symptoms and reducing the effects of other opioids.
answer_blocks.html: Suboxone® is a combination of buprenorphine and naloxone used to manage opioid addiction. It works by easing withdrawal symptoms and reducing the effects of other opioids.

faqs.question: What is Kadian® and how does it work?

answer_blocks.text: Kadian® is an extended-release form of morphine used to manage severe pain. It works by blocking pain signals sent to the brain.
